title: Worth the Trip: What’s the One Meal You’d Fly Across the World For?
summary: CLEAR asked travelers where they’d go just for a meal. Italy led a list filled with pasta, tacos, sushi, jollof rice, seafood, and more.
body_markdown:
Some meals are worth planning a trip around. We asked travelers on Instagram and Reddit the one meal around the world they felt was worth the flight. While their answers included many different destinations and cuisines, one thing remains certain: when the travel day can feel seamless with CLEAR+, the flight to your favorite dish might just be *worth the trip. ‍*


> **Editor’s Note:** Restaurant suggestions are based on current menus and reputable listings, not places named by travelers specifically. We suggest confirming hours, menus, and reservations before visiting.


‍


‍


## Italy Was the Top Food-Travel Destination


Italy received eight of the 27 destination responses. Six Instagram respondents chose pasta or pizza; Reddit added pizza and chicken Parmesan.


Specific cravings included pasta alla vodka, pasta in Rome, and cacio e pepe in Florence.[Cacio e pepe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cacio_e_pepe) combines pasta, Pecorino Romano, and black pepper. In Rome,[Felice a Testaccio](https://feliceatestaccio.com/en/) is known for tossing it tableside. For Neapolitan pizza, consider[L’Antica Pizzeria da Michele](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/campania/napoli/restaurant/da-michele) in Naples.


‍


‍


## Japan Inspired Sushi, Ramen, and Katsu Curry


Japan received five destination responses for sushi, ramen, all-you-can-eat beef, and katsu curry.


One respondent imagined a hole-in-the-wall Osaka ramen shop where a chef had spent decades perfecting[tonkotsu ramen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tonkotsu_ramen) . Tonkotsu originated in Kyushu, but Osaka’s varied ramen scene gives chefs room to personalize the pork-bone broth, noodles, and toppings. Another traveler chose katsu curry: Japanese curry and rice topped with a crisp breaded cutlet.


In Osaka,[ICHIRAN Dotonbori Annex](https://en.ichiran.com/shop/kinki/dotonbori-south/) specializes in tonkotsu ramen.[Sushi Harasho](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/osaka-region/osaka/restaurant/sushi-harasho) offers high-end sushi,[Ganso Tonkatsu Curry Katsuya](https://discover.osaka-info.jp/en/articles/curry-mania) serves katsu curry, and[Yakiniku Rikimaru Shinsaibashi](https://livejapan.com/en/in-kansai/in-pref-osaka/in-namba_dotonbori_shinsaibashi/spot-lj0057754/menu/) offers all-you-can-eat *yakiniku* courses.


‍


‍


## Mexico Inspired Multiple Approaches to the Ideal Meal


Mexico received two responses. One traveler chose Mexico City’s wider food scene, which could mean a taco crawl, neighborhood market, or reservation at[Pujol](https://pujol.com.mx/eng/) .


The other wanted tacos from the coast city of Manzanillo, Colima. Travelers researching current options can start with[Tacos Ramón](https://www.facebook.com/people/TACOS-RAM%C3%93N/100063630065966/) , which has served handmade-tortilla tacos since 1988.


‍


## The Most Memorable Meals Were Personal


One traveler wanted to return to Australia to visit family and share a sausage roll and lamington. A[sausage roll](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sausage_roll) wraps seasoned meat in pastry; Sydney’s[Bourke Street Bakery](https://www.bourkestreetbakery.com.au/) is known for its pork and fennel version. A[lamington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamington) is a sponge cake coated in chocolate and coconut, with[Tokyo Lamington](https://www.tokyolamington.com/) offering classic and creative versions.


One respondent would travel home to their mom’s house for biscuits and gravy. Another joked that they’d go only as far as their kitchen for baked beans. These responses point to the same truth: food can bring us back to comfort, memory, and home.


‍


## Fifteen Countries Made the Menu


Beyond Italy, Japan, and Mexico, travelers named destinations in 12 more countries.


One respondent offered two choices: Peru’s iconic[pollo a la brasa](https://www.peru.travel/stories/delicious-the-history-and-recipe-pollo-a-la-brasa-peruvian-roasted-chicken) and escargot in Paris, France. Peru’s marinated rotisserie chicken is commonly served with fries, salad, and sauces;[La Granja Azul](https://www.granjaazul.com.pe/) traces its version to the dish’s origins. In Paris,[L’Escargot Montorgueil](https://parisjetaime.com/eng/restaurant/l-escargot-montorgueil-p396) has served Burgundy snails for nearly two centuries.


Colombia earned a vote for[bandeja paisa](https://colombia.travel/en/blog/colombian-food-typical-dishes-and-modern-styles) , a platter of beans, rice, meat, egg, plantain, avocado, and arepa.[Hatoviejo](https://hatoviejo.com/menu-de-restaurante-medellin/) serves it at several Medellín locations.


At[Hellshire Beach](https://luxuryjamaicataxi.com/blogs/news/hellshire-beach-jamaica) in Jamaica, fish fry with[bammy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bammy) , a cassava flatbread, and[festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Festival_(food)) , a slightly sweet fried bread, earned a vote as well.[Prendy’s on the Beach](https://www.visitjamaica.com/listing/prendys-on-the-beach/2539/) is one place to start.


Barcelona, Spain was paired with[paella](https://www.spain.info/en/recipe/paella/) , a rice dish prepared with ingredients ranging from meat and beans to seafood. The historic[7 Portes](https://7portes.com/en/) is known for Catalan rice dishes.


Malta was chosen for[pastizzi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pastizz) , flaky pastries commonly filled with ricotta or curried peas. Try them at the iconic[Is Serkin, Crystal Palace](https://hubpymalta.com/what-to-have/restaurant/is-serkin-crystal-palace.html) in Rabat.


Lagos, Nigeria made the list for[jollof rice](https://www.britannica.com/topic/jollof-rice) , made with rice, tomatoes, peppers, onions, and spices.[Molabat Kitchen](https://molabatkitchen.com/) specializes in smoky jollof and has several Lagos locations.


Vienna, Austria was chosen for[Wiener schnitzel](https://www.austria.info/en-us/recipes/wiener-schnitzel/) , a breaded and fried veal cutlet.[Figlmüller](https://www.figlmueller.at/en/) is one of the city’s best-known schnitzel restaurants.


One respondent returned to Inveraray, Scotland, seven years later for another haggis panini.[The George Hotel](https://www.thegeorgehotel.co.uk/food-menus/lunch-dinner-menu) serves traditional[haggis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haggis) , neeps, and tatties as well as haggis bonbons.


Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago made the list for[doubles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doubles_(food)) - curried chickpeas and sauces between fried flatbreads and roti wrapped around curried meat or vegetables. Try[George & Son Doubles and Pies](https://visittrinidad.tt/kiosk-cuisine/george-son-doubles-and-pies/) or[Patraj Roti Shop](https://www.facebook.com/patrajrotiwoodbrook/) .


Another respondent chose a[Monte Cristo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monte_Cristo_sandwich) sandwich in Ashland, Oregon.[The Breadboard](https://www.breadboardashland.com/food/monte-cristo-sandwich/) serves one with turkey, ham, Swiss cheese, and powdered sugar.


‍


## What This Audience Snapshot Tells Us


Travelers who participated in the conversation offered a useful audience snapshot. Instagram leaned toward Italy, while Reddit favored Japan. Respondents also named specific cities, beaches, restaurants, and meals connected to family or memory. Familiar favorites mattered as much as novelty.


‍


## How to Plan a Trip Around One Meal


### Confirm the Details Before You Book


Check the restaurant’s location, opening days, reservation policy, and seasonal schedule. If it’s the reason for your trip, have a backup in case plans change.


### Look Beyond the Famous Places


A destination-worthy meal doesn’t have to come from a famous restaurant. Ask locals about neighborhood favorites, and leave room for smaller spots that reflect the character of the place you’re visiting.


### Consider Food and Water Safety


Foodborne illness can happen at any restaurant; size, popularity, and online reviews don’t guarantee safety. Follow current destination guidance and the[CDC’s food and water precautions](https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/page/food-water-safety) , especially where sanitation or water quality is uncertain.


Wash your hands before eating. Choose food that’s fully cooked and served hot, and use extra care with raw or undercooked meat, seafood, eggs, unpasteurized dairy, untreated water, and ice when you aren’t confident about the source. Travelers with allergies, medical dietary needs, or a higher risk of foodborne illness should confirm ingredients and preparation directly and consult a clinician before travel when appropriate.


### Give the Meal Time the Time It Deserves


Don’t squeeze the experience between a tight connection and departure. Leave time to reach the restaurant, enjoy the meal, and explore the neighborhood.

## What Meal Would You Fly For?


The meal worth traveling for might be one you’ve dreamed of trying, a favorite you want to taste again, or food that brings you back to people and places you miss. Where would you go for one meal?


‍


## Methodology


CLEAR collected 16 Instagram answers and 13 top-level Reddit comments. One nonspecific Reddit comment was excluded. Another Reddit comment named two destinations, and both were counted as full responses, leaving 29 food-and-destination responses across the two platforms. Country totals use the 27 responses that named a travel destination; two home-based answers were included only in the qualitative discussion. Follow-up comments were used for context and weren’t counted as additional responses.


The results are directional and aren’t representative of all travelers.
